99bb7e8053.q: What is Pappaya Gaming and what games does the company develop?
99bb7e8053.a: Pappaya Gaming is an Israeli gaming company with three founders. The company develops casual games including Pingo and Bubbles. These are skill-based games where if you are better than your opponent, you will win when placing a bet. The games involve strategy similar to tournament poker, where skill is the primary factor determining outcomes.

ce44976841.q: How does Inon Golan view the evolution of R&D in the technology sector?
ce44976841.a: Golan describes technology development as working in cycles, with periods of high tech followed by low tech, similar to a sine wave pattern. He emphasizes that the key differentiator today is the speed of change rather than the technology itself. He believes the role of R&D is becoming more expensive and complex, and that many professionals entering the field need to understand this cyclical nature and prepare for continuous adaptation.
